ext.description: Unity 6 development support for Visual Studio Code: snippets, CodeLens, hover docs, .meta sync and documentation search.
config.title: Unity SW Pack
config.unityEventMessage: Mark the methods Unity calls for you, such as Awake, Start and Update.
config.usageScenePrefab: Show how many scenes and prefabs use the current script.
config.unityMessageHover: Explain what a Unity message does when you hover over it.
config.typeToggle: Offer a one-click switch between void and IEnumerator so a method can become a coroutine.
config.metaFileSync: Keep .meta files in step when you rename or delete assets in the editor.
config.searchInUnityDocs: Add a command that searches the selected word in the Unity documentation for your project version.
config.unityEventLens: Show where a method or UnityEvent field is wired up in scenes and prefabs.
config.onlyScenesInBuildSettings: Only read UnityEvent wiring from the scenes listed in EditorBuildSettings. Reference counts still cover every scene.
config.debugLogging: Write indexing details to the Unity SW Pack output channel. Turn this on when reporting a problem.
config.diagnostics: Report Unity problems the editor cannot see: a script whose file name does not match its class, a scene or prefab attaching a script that no longer exists, and two scripts sharing a GUID.
config.performanceDiagnostics: Also point out costly calls inside Unity callbacks that run every frame, such as Camera.main, GameObject.Find and GetComponent. Turn this off if you already use Microsoft.Unity.Analyzers.
cmd.openAssetReference: Open a scene or prefab that uses this script
